name: archi-tts
description: Local Vietnamese (Northern accent) text-to-speech for video dubbing, served over MCP. 15 built-in VieNeu voices plus OmniVoice voice cloning with emotion clips; multi-voice scripts with pauses, emphasis, speed, pitch and volume; exports WAV, MP3 and SRT. Runs fully offline on Apple Silicon after a one-time ~4.5 GB model download, which starts automatically on first session.
